messages:
elaine: FYI: nightly candidate-bench matrix flagged a fallback-heavy path for PR #4521 on ampere-midseq with KV cache disabled. latency +18% vs baseline, p50/p95 drift. uploading artifacts. :eyes:
kevin: link? can you paste the failing microbench config and the seed used?
elaine: report: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/bench/3890001111/report.html
elaine: command we ran: `./bench --matrix configs/candidate_matrix.json --runs 200 --seed 2021 --kv-cache off`
perf-bot: microbench summary: ampere-midseq | kernel: kern_v2_autotune | kv_cache: off | seq=256 | p50: 12.4ms (baseline 10.5ms) | p95: 48.1ms (baseline 40.2ms) | regress +18% p50, +19% p95
sofia: hmm, that kernel historically regresses only when prefill batching falls back to scalar path. did the harness hit prefill fallback?
arjun: I checked the raw logs — there are a bunch of FUSED_KERNEL fallbacks at prefill stage when seq>128, plus a few kernel-timeout retries.
kevin: timeout retries = suspicious. could be noisy infra on that runner or nondeterministic kernel probe order. did we run with deterministic thread affinity?
elaine: we did not pin affinity in that run. matrix runner is the new multi-arch pool (ampere batch nodes), might be noisy. but the regressions are consistent across 7/8 runs.
sofia: two angles: 1) fix harness nondeterminism (pin CPU/GPU affinity + set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES) 2) tighten CI gating so flaky infra doesn't block candidate kernels but still surfaces real regressions.
perf-bot: run details: artifacts include `kernel_trace.log` (contains fallback reasons) and `cuda_env.txt`
arjun: excerpt from kernel_trace.log: `PREFILL: attempted fused_fastpath -> exit_reason=KV_CACHE_MISS -> fallback_to: scalar_prefill` repeated 42x
kevin: KV_CACHE_MISS on ampere? that's odd — we saw that pattern last month when the autotuner's KV layout heuristic mispredicted tag alignment for 256 tokens. could be a quantization packing regression in kern_v2_autotune.
sofia: proposal: add microbench variant that forces KV warmup (prefix cache fill) before measuring p50 to separate cold-cache vs steady-state. also add `--pin-affinity` flag to runner.
elaine: agree. I'll add a short follow-up run with `--seed 42 --pin-affinity` and `--warmup 50` and post results.
ci-bot: queued job 3890001111-2 on ampere-24gb-3 (runner-07). estimated runtime 12m.
arjun: while that's running, we should change the nightly gating: if p50 regresses >10% AND fallback_count increased >5x then auto-open a triage ticket; if p50 regresses but fallback_count stable then mark as infra-flake and rerun.
kevin: +1. also add an extra determinism step: `--seed` must be included in matrix config for candidate kernels. flakiness dropped significantly when we enforced seed in previous sweep.
sofia: action items: Elaine -> run pinned/warmup microbench and link artifacts. Arjun -> add fallback_count metric to harness summary. Kevin -> update matrix template to require `seed` and optional `pin_affinity`. I'll PR the gating rule change after CI run.
elaine: started follow-up run: command `./bench --matrix configs/candidate_matrix.json --runs 300 --seed 42 --pin-affinity --warmup 50 --kv-cache off`
perf-bot: follow-up queued: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/bench/3890001111/followup-42.html
sofia: great. if follow-up shows <5% p50 delta then we tag original as infra-flake and requeue candidate. if still >12% we'll need to revert kernel or add architecture-specific guard.
kevin: also check quant packing tests in `tests/quant_pack/ampere` — if packing changed, that would explain the KV misses.
arjun: noted. I'll prototype a quick KV alignment check that runs during kernel onboarding and emits a `kv_alignment_score`. if score < threshold, autotuner should pick alternate kernel.
elaine: thanks everyone. I'll post results in this thread when follow-up completes. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: follow-up job completed (success). artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/bench/3890001111/followup-42.html
perf-bot: follow-up summary: ampere-midseq | kernel: kern_v2_autotune | kv_cache: off | warmup=50 | pin_affinity | p50: 10.8ms | baseline 10.5ms | delta +2.9% | fallback_count reduced from 42 to 3
sofia: that looks like infra/determinism. fallback_count drop is the key. reopening candidate is reasonable.
kevin: I'll open a small patch to require `--pin-affinity` and `--warmup` in the nightly runner and add seed enforcement.
arjun: I'll still add the `kv_alignment_score` check as a safety net for future kernel onboarding.
elaine: reopening PR #4521 and requeueing candidate matrix. thanks everyone. :rocket:
